ruleset.name: jpinpoint-remoting-rules
ruleset.description: jPinpoint rule set for performance aware Kotlin coding, sponsored by Rabobank.

rule.name: HttpClientBuilderWithoutDisableConnectionState
rule.message: A HttpClient builder is used and disableConnectionState is not called. HTTP client tracks connection state while using TLS.
rule.description: Problem: NTLM authenticated connections and SSL/TLS connections with client certificate authentication are stateful: they have a specific user identity/security context per session. If HttpClients have enabled connection state tracking which is the default, established TLS connections will not be reused because it is assumed that the user identity or security context may differ. Then performance will suffer due to a full TLS handshake for each request. Solution: HttpClients should disable connection state tracking in order to reuse TLS connections, since service calls for one pool have the same user identity/security context for all sessions. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: (:locally created http client builder without disableConnectionState :) //PostfixUnarySuffix//SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text="custom" and ancestor::PostfixUnaryExpression/PrimaryExpression/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier/@Text="HttpClients" and not(ancestor::PostfixUnaryExpression/PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier/@Text="disableConnectionState")] , //PostfixUnarySuffix//SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text="create" and ancestor::PostfixUnaryExpression/PrimaryExpression/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[(@Text="HttpClientBuilder" or @Text="HttpAsyncClientBuilder") and not(ancestor::PostfixUnaryExpression/PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier/@Text="disableConnectionState")]] , (: method param http client builder without disableConnectionState :) //FunctionValueParameter/Parameter/Type/TypeReference/UserType/SimpleUserType/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[(@Text="HttpClients" or @Text="HttpClientBuilder" or @Text="HttpAsyncClientBuilder") and not(ancestor::FunctionDeclaration//PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier/@Text="disableConnectionState")]

rule.example: private fun createHttpClientBuilder(properties: ConnectionProperties) = HttpClients.custom() .setDefaultRequestConfig(createRequestConfig(properties)) .setMaxConnTotal(properties.maxConnTotal) .setMaxConnPerRoute(properties.maxConnPerRoute) // violation, no disableConnectionState() call

rule.name: AvoidDeprecatedHystrix
rule.message: Netflix Hystrix is deprecated. Use an alternative like resilience4j
rule.description: Problem: Hystrix is not actively maintained anymore. Solution: Netflix recommends to use open source alternatives like resilience4j. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: HttpClientBuilderWithoutPoolSize
rule.message: HttpClient builder v4/v5 is used and the connection pool is not configured: defaults of 2/5 per route and 20/25 max total are probably not right (for v4/v5).
rule.description: Problem: Apache HttpClient has low default pool sizes (v4: 2 per route, 20 total; v5: 5 per route, 25 total) which can cause contention under concurrency. Solution: Explicitly configure pool sizes. Either set a connection manager and configure it with setMaxTotal and setDefaultMaxPerRoute, or call setMaxConnTotal and setMaxConnPerRoute on the client builder (v4 only). (jpinpoint-rules)
